title: land's rebase message counts the local commits left after the rebase, and the merge and conflict paths are tested
goal: bl_land's rebase of an orchestrator checkout reports git rev-list --count upstream..HEAD after the rebase, not before, and the merge-commit and conflict paths each have a test case

run:
import sys, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib, io, contextlib, os
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_land
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
ENV = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='a', GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='a@example.com', GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='a', GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='a@example.com')
def g(*a, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *a], cwd=t, env=dict(ENV, **kw), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
g('init', '-q', '-b', 'main')
d = t / 'kb' / '_self' / 'backlog'; d.mkdir(parents=True)
def commit(name, text, msg, **kw):
    (d / name).write_text(text); g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', msg, **kw)
commit('BG-aaaaaaaa.json', '0\n', 'base')
base = g('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip()
commit('BG-aaaaaaaa.json', '1\n', 'item a')
commit('BG-bbbbbbbb.json', '1\n', 'item b')
g('checkout', '-q', '-b', 'up', base)
commit('BG-aaaaaaaa.json', '1\n', 'item a upstream copy', GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2030-01-01T00:00:00')
commit('BG-cccccccc.json', '1\n', 'item c')
g('update-ref', 'refs/remotes/origin/main', g('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip())
g('checkout', '-q', 'main')
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    bl_land.rebase_local(str(t), 'origin', 'main', 2, 'origin/main')
out = buf.getvalue()
n = g('rev-list', '--count', 'origin/main..HEAD').strip()
sys.exit(0 if n == '1' and f'{n} local commit(s)' in out and 'rebased' in out else 1)
